title: UX Data Table Model Compiler
description: Validates data table specs: column definitions, pagination requirements, selection state, loading state, empty state, sortable column alignment, bulk action confirmations, and contract attestation. Produces data-table-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract data-table-spec.json from feature brief and column definitions

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate spec shape, loading state, and empty state declarations

pipeline.title: Interaction
pipeline.description: Validate paging requirements, selection state, and sortable column alignment

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: data-table-spec.json exists with table_id(string), columns(array), pagination(object); each column has id+label+field; pagination has pageSize(number)

gates.title: Loading State
gates.description: Spec must declare loadingState: skeleton, spinner, or overlay

gates.title: Empty Table State
gates.description: Spec must declare emptyState with message(string) — blank table with no feedback is a violation

gates.title: Paging Required
gates.description: If estimatedRowCount > 25 or pagination.required:true, pageSize must be > 0 and <= 100

gates.title: Selection State
gates.description: If selectable:true, selectionState must declare maxSelection and bulkActions array

gates.title: Sortable Columns Valid
gates.description: Any column with sortable:true must be listed in spec.sortableColumns or have a corresponding sort spec

gates.title: Bulk Actions Confirmation
gates.description: Any bulkAction with destructive:true must declare confirmation object with message(string)

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled data table specs

error_codes.UDT001: data-table-spec.json missing or invalid — table_id, columns, pagination required
error_codes.UDT002: Pagination not declared for large dataset — pageSize must be 1-100
error_codes.UDT003: selectable:true but selectionState missing maxSelection or bulkActions
error_codes.UDT004: loadingState missing — must be skeleton, spinner, or overlay
error_codes.UDT005: emptyState missing or missing message — blank tables must have feedback
error_codes.UDT006: Sortable column has no sort definition — column.sortable:true requires a sort spec entry
error_codes.UDT008: Data table contract violation — version, unique column ids, or pageSize invalid
